heroHeadline: Day 98: CNN World Cup Security Assessment Flags CJNG Shadow Over Guadalajara; Plan Kukulkan 11 Days; El Sapo At Large
heroSubtitle: Day 98 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). CNN WORLD CUP SECURITY ASSESSMENT (May 31): CNN published a major security assessment evaluating risks for World Cup fans in Mexico's three host cities — flagging CJNG's ongoing succession crisis and cartel presence in Jalisco as structural concerns for Guadalajara's four group-stage matches, 11 days before the June 11 FIFA opening. Plan Kukulkan's 99,000+ security deployment acknowledged; El Sapo's continued freedom at large cited as the primary unresolved security variable. CARTEL FIFA BLACKOUT DIRECTIVE (Day 97): CJNG and Jalisco cartel factions reportedly issued internal directives ordering operatives to avoid high-visibility violence during the World Cup tournament (June 11–July 19) — reflecting cartel calculations that major attacks risk direct U.S. military intervention under existing Trump pressure. Analysts note these directives reflect temporary operational calculus, not structural change; post-tournament return to baseline violence is the historical norm. PLAN KUKULKAN — 11 DAYS: Eleven days remain before the FIFA World Cup 2026 opening match (June 11, Estadio Azteca, Mexico City vs. South Africa). SEDENA confirmed the plan is proceeding as planned: 20,000 Armed Forces, 55,000 federal/state police, 188 canine units, 2,100 military vehicles, 24 aircraft/drones deployed across host cities. Guadalajara (Akron Stadium, 4 matches) under heightened CJNG-specific protocols; U.S. special forces continue training Mexican military on stadium attack prevention and drone bomb defense. EL SAPO HUNT — DAY 98: Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán ('El Sapo' / 'El 090') remains at large as Mexico's #1 CJNG enforcement target — no capture, elimination, or credible sighting. MANZANILLO COMMAND VOID — DAY 22: 22 days since El Chucky's arrest (May 9); no confirmed successor plaza boss. CJNG COLOMBIAN MERCENARIES — PURÉPECHA PLATEAU: Michoacán AG-confirmed 60+ Colombian paramilitary operatives across 10 municipalities in ongoing offensive (Zamora, Jacona, Tangamandapio, Chilchota, Charapan, Paracho, Cherán, Nahuatzen, Los Reyes, Tangancícuaro). CIAGATE FGR INVESTIGATION (Day 98): Ongoing — 'coordination without subordination' Mullin-Sheinbaum framework active; June bilateral meeting scheduled. JUNE BILATERAL MEETING: Mullin-Sheinbaum high-level security meeting scheduled for June 2026 — the post-World Cup bilateral reset point. SUCCESSION BINARY: El 03 (confirmed leader) vs. El Sapo (military wing, at large). DECAPITATION LEDGER: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Doble R (arrested Mar 11), El Jardinero (arrested Apr 27; extradition suspended), El Güero Conta (arrested Apr 27), El Chipo/Jorge N (arrested May 19), El Cabo (arrested May 7), El Chucky/Manzanillo (arrested May 9), El Checo/Tecate (arrested May 13). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials. 47+ CJNG HVTs neutralized.
